items.title: Entry Tickets & Meals Not Included
items.text: Entry tickets, cable cars, mountain railways, train tickets, meals and restaurants are paid directly by you on-site.

items.title: A Private Chauffeur Service
items.text: Our service is a private chauffeur-driven journey — your driver accompanies and guides you throughout the day.

items.title: Airport Transfer Included
items.text: Transfer from Zurich Airport to Zurich city or Lucerne is always included.

items.title: Fixed Price, No Meter
items.text: A fixed price is agreed in advance — no taximeter, no surprises.

items.title: Free Cancellation
items.text: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before your booking.

items.title: How Payment Works
items.text: Full prepayment by card is required to confirm your booking. Contact us directly to reserve your journey — we will provide bank details for payment.

footer.tagline: Private Mercedes-Benz chauffeur experiences across Zurich, Lucerne and the Swiss Alps.
